purpose: Teach: 歓声/一節/サントラ/裏話/夜行/見栄え/新春/旅客機

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ライブの、本気で、絶対、歓声、絶対、ヤバかったね
lines.en: Riku, the crowd energy at that live was absolutely insane.
lines.style: Bright, rapid-fire excitement. Leaning forward. Energy still buzzing from the memory. No filter between thought and voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、お気に入りの、絶対、一節、絶対、何度も聞いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were seriously listening to your favorite verse over and over, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft observation, almost gentle. A small smile in the voice. Not calling her out — noticing her. The tone of someone who listens to his friends.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、サントラ、絶対、買ったの?本気で
lines.en: Wait — you actually bought the soundtrack?
lines.style: Genuine surprise underneath the question. Quick, unprepared. The vocal equivalent of a doubled-take. Warm curiosity, not judgment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、芸人の、絶対、裏話、絶対、知ってるな、桜
lines.en: So you know the behind-the-scenes stories about those comedians, huh, Sakura?
lines.style: Quietly impressed. Leaning in slightly. The tone of someone who didn't expect that detail. Soft, genuinely curious — not showing off that he cares about the answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、夜行、絶対、バス、絶対、で、絶対、修学旅行、絶対、行くんだろ?本気で
lines.en: You're taking the night bus to school trip, right? With everyone?
lines.style: Casual check-in that carries real interest. Steady pace, no rush. Testing the ground gently. The question of someone who wants to know but won't push.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお弁当の、本気で、絶対、見栄え、絶対、すげえな、桜
lines.en: Your bento always looks so good, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine, understated praise. Said almost to himself. Brief breath before the words — like he didn't entirely plan to say it out loud. Warm without being performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、本気で、絶対、新春、絶対、ライブ、絶対、お前、絶対、行く?本気で
lines.en: Are you going to the New Year live, Riku?
lines.style: Hopeful beneath the casual question. Careful not to sound too invested. Quick delivery on the ask. Eyes up, waiting for the answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、旅客機、絶対、お父さんの仕事で、絶対、よく乗るんだろ?桜
lines.en: You fly a lot for your dad's work, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, almost wistful. Slower pace. The question of someone imagining something foreign and interesting. Warm, not envious.
